title: {Syn} A Star Adds a Compass to Shortest Paths
content:
A* search extends Dijkstra algorithm with a heuristic estimate of the remaining distance to the goal. A good admissible heuristic can dramatically reduce search.

The method is a staple in games, robotics, and route planning because it balances exactness with directed exploration.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
